approval_ref: The user approved the ponytail/grill development plan and asked CIRP development, testing and iteration to continue, with API calls allowed only after the offline implementation gate.
notes: Keep the public QA V3 result contract and every existing citation, entity, numeric and arithmetic safety check.

Reduce only the provider-facing ANSWER payload: the model supplies atomic claims, exact citations and cited arithmetic operands; CIRP locally compiles the canonical answer text and arithmetic results.
Treat bounded extraction, listing and explicitly requested basic arithmetic as supported project-document work instead of asking the model to invent a second task classifier.
Derive a safe validator category for saved evaluation failures from the existing settled call diagnostic and execution receipt without a migration or rejected output retention.
Use synthetic offline tests for this implementation task. Run the separately authorized fixed-15 live benchmark only after the complete repository gate passes.
title: Make the Reference QA decision contract reliable
objective: Make grounded QA V3 answers easier for strong and small models to express while CIRP locally compiles redundant answer and arithmetic fields and exposes only safe failure diagnostics.
